name: @markdrop/design-system
description: Markdrop design system: tokens (dark + light), fonts, logos, React components and previews.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && npm run check:contrast && npm run build:bundle && npm run build:types
scripts.build:types: tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --jsx react-jsx --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --moduleResolution node --target es2019 --lib es2019,dom --outDir bundle/types
